tasks.title: Strip current and the BEC rating
tasks.solution: The strip current is I = n · 0.06 A; the sum with the other loads; the BEC rating ≥ 1.5 × (n · 0.06 + the others).

tasks.title: How many LEDs a BEC can handle
tasks.solution: What is left for the strip is b / 1.5 − the others; divide by 0.06 A and round down: n = ⌊(b / 1.5 − the others) / 0.06⌋.

tasks.title: The number of shots on a leg
tasks.solution: The shots are tied to the distance since arming: n = ⌊(d₀ + L) / N⌋ − ⌊d₀ / N⌋. A plain ⌊L / N⌋ can be off by one shot.

tasks.title: A mode range boundary
tasks.solution: The range is stored in steps of 25 µs from 900: step = ⌊(v − 900) / 25⌋, and 900 + 25 · step is printed back.
